﻿# Feiyu Desktop — a desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness

A small, always-on-top whale girl that lives in the corner of your Windows desktop, mirrors the
mood

of the `dsh-feiyu-mood` plugin, and — this is the fun part — **talks to you without you opening
the

eiyu-mood` plugin, and — this is the fun part — **talks to you without you opening
the DSH window**.

Built with nothing but Windows PowerShell 5.1 + WPF. No installer, no Electron, no background
servic

ilt with nothing but Windows PowerShell 5.1 + WPF. No installer, no Electron, no background
service.
If this project makes your desktop a little less lonely, a ⭐ helps other people find it.
## Why a separate program
`dsh-feiyu-mood` renders the companion inside the DSH web UI. This project lifts the same character
out of the app window: a transparent, per-pixel hit-tested, always-on-top WPF window that reads the

plugin's state file. Chat goes through a tiny Cordis plugin (`bridge/`) that runs one-shot model
cal
ls inside the DSH Host process — the pet never touches your conversation context.
## Features

- **Mood mirror** — reads `<DSH_HOME>/feiyu-mood/state.json` every 1.2 s; five faces,
seven emotion

bars, last judgement reason, recent history (click the pet to open the panel).
- **Idle motion** — g

entle breathing scaled from the feet (no floating), slow gaze drop every few
seconds, a springy hop

on click. Blinking is intentionally off: the upstream plugin ships no
closed-eye frame that matches

the open-eye sprites (see `CREDITS.md`).
- **Chat without DSH in the foreground** — write a line, th

e bridge runs one model call and streams
the answer back into her speech bubble, one character at a

time. Closing the input row
(click anywhere else) drops the bubble back down onto her head instead o

f leaving it floating.
- **Emotion memory** — persistent affection/trust/energy that drift over time

, plus a hot layer
(last N turns) and a warm layer (model-compressed notes every M turns). No cold d

iary yet.
- **She starts conversations** — after a quiet spell (about 25 minutes by default) she say

s something on her
own, and a few minutes after a chat she follows up on what you said.
She also rem

embers when you said you were going somewhere: tell her “I am off to a meeting / lunch / class”
and
later she asks “how did the meeting go?” instead of a bare “still there?” (same thing at most twice,

90 min apart).
Interval and on/off live in her settings (`proactive`, `proactiveMinutes`).
- **Her

own settings window** (right-click → settings): memory on/off, retain/compress cadence,
“know what I

'm busy with”, autostart, bubble seconds, refresh interval, model override.
The footer of that windo

w shows the version and build number of the copy you are running
(`v1.0.0 · build 13 · 2026-10-27`),

and the tray tooltip carries the same string.
Saved to `widget/pet-settings.json`; both the widget

and the bridge read it live.
- **English interface** — her settings window has an “English interface

” checkbox that flips every
label (panel, menus, tray, balloon, chat bar, idle lines) between 中文 and

English. The same switch is

## Requirements

- Windows 10 / 11
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 (built in)
- DeepSeek Harness desktop app **with the `dsh

-feiyu-mood`
plugin installed** — that plugin writes the mood state and ships the character art this

widget uses
- For chat: the `bridge/` plugin added to the same DSH profile

## Usage
| Action | Result |

| Left click | hop + open chat input |
| Double click | she says a random line |

## Privacy
- The widget only reads local files (`state.json`, `config.json`, `pet-settings.json`) and the bridg

e
directory.
- Chat text goes to the model provider configured in your DSH profile; nothing is sent

anywhere else.
- Memory is plain JSON on your disk (`bridge/memory.json`); delete it to forget every

re else.
- Memory is plain JSON on your disk (`bridge/memory.json`); delete it to forget everything.
## Where this comes from — and what is ours
This project is a **fork-and-extend of someone else's work**, and we want that to be obvious before

s a **fork-and-extend of someone else's work**, and we want that to be obvious before
anything else.

**Standing on:** `dsh-feiyu-mood` by
Yuuyuko-uu (MIT license). From that project we take:

- the character 「小鱼 / 肥鱼」 and the five expression illustrations in `widget/assets/`;
- the mood mode

l itself (seven emotions, decay, the state file this widget reads);
- the idea of a small companion
living in the corner of the UI.
If you reuse the artwork or the mood system, **credit that project too** — it is the foundation.

**Added here:** the standalone WPF desktop widget (`widget/`), the file-bridge Cordis plugin
(`bridg

e/`) that allows chatting without opening DSH, the emotion/relationship layer, the hot-and-warm
memo

ry compression, the settings window, edge snapping, fullscreen auto-hide, tray/watchdog and
system-w

, the settings window, edge snapping, fullscreen auto-hide, tray/watchdog and
system-wide packaging.
